A merge to master is followed by a recording pull request that lands its run's executions in the ledger. A claim then reads `proven` at a trunk commit that nothing but ledger-only commits separates from the recorded one, and `inputs_unchanged` or `stale`, naming what changed, where other merges landed in between; whether the process makes the first the rule is the owner's decision (ADR <n1/>, Consequences). A skipped test reads `not_run` with its reason, and no surface anywhere reads greener than the ledger for the revision it presents.

Po merge na master následuje zaznamenávací pull request, který přistane provedení svého běhu v knize. Tvrzení pak na commitu trunku, od zaznamenaného odděleném jen commity pouze s knihou, čte `proven`, a tam, kde mezitím přistály jiné merge, `inputs_unchanged` nebo `stale` s uvedením, co se změnilo; zda proces učiní první pravidlem, je rozhodnutí vlastníka (ADR <n1/>, Consequences). en: ADR <n1/> and ADR <n2/> made every interface of the Rust executable a projection of one capability registry and reconciled the generated documents under <t1/> with <t2/>. Two projections every worker meets before anything else were still outside that pipeline. The provider bootstraps, <t3/>, <t4/>, <t5/>, were rendered only by the shell tool's <t6/> and judged only by the shell <t7/>'s stamp comparison; CI did not compare them with the policy, so a rule typed into <t8/> by hand would have merged. The site had no view of the registry at all, and a page that showed one would have had to hand-maintain a second list of operations and kinds. The operator asked for one compiled control plane: canonical inputs, a deterministic registry, and every provider file, document and page a one-way projection of it, with a manual edit of any projection failing the build rather than warning.

Bootstrapy providerů, <t3/>, <t4/>, <t5/>, vykresloval jen <t6/> shellového nástroje a posuzovalo je jen porovnání razítek shellového <t7/>; CI je s politikou neporovnávalo, takže pravidlo ručně napsané do <t8/> by prošlo merge. Web neměl na registr žádný pohled a stránka, která by jej ukazovala, by musela ručně udržovat druhý seznam operací a druhů.
